propositions: 836 unmarked bridge-echo comments across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) lack the reconciler marker because truncation appends the marker after the body, cutting it off at 32767 raw characters.
Comments are identified as deletion candidates by two conjunctive conditions: body contains the truncation suffix '[truncated by reconciler]' AND body does NOT contain RECONCILER_MARKER.
Phase 2 deletes 827 duplicate comments (keep-one rule: oldest copy per distinct normalized body survives) with zero data loss across the three issues.
After bridge re-enablement, the first pass will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment due to empty comment_ids map, then dedupe from pass 2 onward.

Final sweep after first re-enabled pass must invert the keep-one rule: retain the copy whose id appears in bindings.json comment_ids map, not the oldest, to avoid orphaning recorded ids and recreating the original defect.
